question_text: Why is it that mutations are considered as one of the raw materials of evolution?
options: They contribute to new variations in organisms
They are usually related to environment in which they appear
They are mostly beneficial to the environment in which they appear
They usually become the causes for species extinction
explanation: Mutations create new genetic variations in populations, providing the diversity upon which natural selection can act.

question_text: Which one of the following is consistent with understanding of human evolution?
options: Bipedalism was never important in human evolution
Larger brain size had no contribution to evolution of human species
Human ancestry has no relation whatsoever with that of the chimpanzees
Fossils of Lucy and Ardi provided evidence for human origin
explanation: Lucy (Australopithecus afarensis) and Ardi (Ardipithecus ramidus) are key hominid fossils that provide evidence for early human evolution.
